This guide takes an application built on FSC v0.28.0 to v0.29.0. Coming from an older release, first follow [v0.27-to-v0.28.md](https://github.com/hyperledger-labs/fabric-smart-client/blob/v0.29.0/docs/upgrade/v0.27-to-v0.28.md).

Every organization upgrades in the same window (see [Storage](https://github.com/hyperledger-labs/fabric-smart-client/blob/v0.29.0/docs/upgrade/v0.28-to-v0.29.md#storage)).

## Checklist

Operators:

- Run `node migrate --contract` once no node runs v0.28; see [Storage](https://github.com/hyperledger-labs/fabric-smart-client/blob/v0.29.0/docs/upgrade/v0.28-to-v0.29.md#storage) and [schema migrations](https://github.com/hyperledger-labs/fabric-smart-client/blob/v0.29.0/docs/platform/view/services/schema-migrations.md).

### Developers

- Nothing to change.

Full guide: https://github.com/hyperledger-labs/fabric-smart-client/blob/v0.29.0/docs/upgrade/v0.28-to-v0.29.md

## Upgrade

Stop-all upgrade: every node of a network stops before any node runs v0.29.0.

## Tested with

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| Go | 1.27.3 |
| Hyperledger Fabric | 3.1.4 |

| Fabric-x tools | v1.0.3 |
| PostgreSQL | 16.2 |

## Schema steps

| Store | Step | Name | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|
| kvs | 1 | create table | free |
| vault | 1 | create tables | free |
| vault | 2 | metadata as protobuf | restore from backup |

|---|---|---|
